1794 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 100 unless divisible by 400; 1794 not divisible by 4).  
84 days before June 21, 1794:  
Back up 11 days → June 10, 1794.  
Back up 31 more days (May) → April 10, 1794.  
Back up 30 more days (April) → March 11, 1794.  
Remaining days: 84 - 11 - 31 - 30 = 12 days earlier in March.  
March 11 minus 12 days = February 28, 1794 (March has 31 days, so March 11 → March 1 is 10 days back, need 2 more days back into February: Feb 28).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1794-02-28
